integrity: The proof is a direct consequence of the independently checked degree and second-coefficient formulas for spiral knots together with the coprimality in the definition. Finite computation checks arithmetic instances only and is not used as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The divisor sieve gives necessary conditions only and does not assert realization of surviving parameter pairs or determine the sign vector. The uniqueness theorem requires the adjacent-coefficient gap |a1|-1 to be prime.
title: Prime-gap Alexander coefficients determine spiral-knot parameters
